arxiv-2101-00846.creator: Quentin Guignard
arxiv-2101-00846.description: Abstract . We introduce a notion of compatibility for families ( ℱ ℓ ) ℓ (\mathcal{F}_{\ell})_{\ell} of bounded constructible ℓ \ell -adic complexes of étale sheaves on schemes. For schemes of finite type over a field, this notion is preserved by the usual six functors.

arxiv-2102-09576.description: Abstract We present the bolometric lightcurve, identification and analysis of the progenitor candidate, and preliminary modelling of AT 2016jbu (Gaia16cfr). We find a progenitor consistent with a ∼ \sim 22–25 M ⊙ yellow hypergiant surrounded by a dusty circumstellar shell, in agreement with what has been previously reported.

arxiv-2107-03265.title: Contrastive Explanations for Argumentation-Based Conclusions
arxiv-2107-03265.creator: AnneMarie Borg, Floris Bex
arxiv-2107-03265.description: Abstract In this paper we discuss contrastive explanations for formal argumentation – the question why a certain argument (the fact) can be accepted, whilst another argument (the foil) cannot be accepted under various extension-based semantics. The recent work on explanations for argumentation-based conclusions has mostly focused on providing minimal explanations for the (non-)acceptance of arguments.

Atomic ionised regions with strong continuum emission are often associated with regions of high-mass star formation and low-frequency ( < < 2 GHz) observations of these regions are needed to help build star formation models.

arxiv-2502-09514.title: Continuous-Variable Quantum MacWilliams Identities
arxiv-2502-09514.creator: Ansgar G. Burchards
arxiv-2502-09514.description: Abstract We derive bounds on general quantum error correcting codes against the displacement noise channel. The bounds limit the distances attainable by codes and also apply in an approximate setting. Our main result is a quantum analogue of the classical Cohn-Elkies bound on sphere packing densities attainable in Euclidean space.

arxiv-2504-18402.title: Analytic solution for the nonlinear response of magnetic nanoparticles to large-amplitude oscillatory fields
arxiv-2504-18402.creator: Patrick Ilg
arxiv-2504-18402.description: Abstract Nonlinear responses of physical systems to strong perturbations are notoriously difficult to tackle analytically. Here, we present analytic results for the nonlinear response of magnetic nanoparticles to large-amplitude oscillatory magnetic fields based on a particular model for the magnetization dynamics. A number of characteristic features of the in-phase and out-of-phase higher-harmonic response are found and analyzed.

arxiv-2512-16153.title: A Square Kilometre Array Pulsar Census
arxiv-2512-16153.creator: E. F. Keane 1, V. Graber 2, L. Levin 3, C. M. Tan 4, O. A. Johnson 1, C. Ng 5, C. Pardo-Araujo 6,7, M. Ronchi 8, D. Vohl 8, M. Xue 9, The SKA Pulsar Science Working Group
arxiv-2512-16153.description: Abstract Most of the pulsar science case with the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) depends on long-term precision pulsar timing of a large number of pulsars, as well as astrometric measurements of these using very long baseline interferometry (VLBI). But before we can time them, or VLBI them, we must first find them.

arxiv-2512-22929.title: Low-energy
arxiv-2512-22929.creator: e
arxiv-2512-22929.description: Abstract We present a fully differential computation of e^{+}\,e^{-}\to\gamma\,\gamma at next-to-next-to-leading order in QED. The process has been implemented into McMule , completing its set of next-to-next-to-leading-order calculations for the most important 2\to{2} processes. The results allow for generic applications to electron-positron colliders with centre-of-mass energies up to a few GeV, particularly for luminosity measurements.

pmc-10481508.title: Neurodegeneration or dysfunction in Phelan-McDermid syndrome? A multimodal approach with CSF and computational MRI
pmc-10481508.creator: Sarah Jesse, Hans-Peter Müller, Hans-Jürgen Huppertz, Stephanie Andres, Albert C Ludolph, Michael Schön, Tobias M Boeckers, Jan Kassubek
pmc-10481508.description: BackgroundPhelan-McDermid syndrome (PMS) is a rare multisystem disease with global developmental delay and autistic features. Genetically, the disease is based on a heterozygous deletion of chromosome 22q13.3 with involvement of at least part of the SHANK3 gene or heterozygous pathogenic variants in SHANK3.

pmc-10542274.title: Gut content metabarcoding of specialized feeders is not a replacement for environmental DNA assays of seawater in reef environments
pmc-10542274.creator: Joseph D. DiBattista, Shang Yin Vanson Liu, Maarten De Brauwer, Shaun P. Wilkinson, Katrina West, Adam Koziol, Michael Bunce
pmc-10542274.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In tropical marine ecosystems, the coral-based diet of benthic-feeding reef fishes provides a window into the composition and health of coral reefs. In this study, for the first time, we compare multi-assay metabarcoding sequences of environmental DNA (eDNA) isolated from seawater and partially digested gut items from an obligate corallivore butterflyfish (Chaetodon lunulatus) resident to coral reef sites in the South China Sea.

pmc-11395619.title: Autoimmune Mast Cell Activation Test as a Diagnostic Tool in Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria
pmc-11395619.creator: Ana Koren, Luka Dejanović, Matija Rijavec, Peter Kopač, Mojca Bizjak, Mihaela Zidarn, Mitja Košnik, Peter Korošec
pmc-11395619.description: Chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) is associated with skin mast cell activation, and its triggering mechanisms are not completely elucidated. Evidence suggests an autoimmune component of CSU. Our aim was to assess the usefulness of an autoimmune mast cell activation test (aiMAT) for diagnosing and differentiating CSU into different subtypes.

pmc-11479191.title: Enhancing Antibiotic Efficacy with Natural Compounds: Synergistic Activity of Tannic Acid and Nerol with Commercial Antibiotics against Pathogenic Bacteria
pmc-11479191.creator: Guillermo Lorca, Diego Ballestero, Elisa Langa, María Rosa Pino-Otín, Nicholas J Sadgrove
pmc-11479191.description: The search for synergies between natural products and commercial antibiotics is a promising strategy against bacterial resistance. This study determined the antimicrobial capacity of Nerol (NE) and Tannic Acid (TA) against 14 pathogenic bacteria, including ESKAPE pathogens. TA exhibited the lowest Minimum Inhibitory Concentrations (MICs) at 162.5 µg/mL against Pasteurella aerogenes and 187.5 µg/mL against Acinetobacter baumannii (WHO priority 1).

pmc-11661714.title: Gaining Insight into Operative Performance: Analysis of an Automated 360-Degree Feedback Tool Among Perioperative Staff
pmc-11661714.creator: Stefanie J. Soelling, Robert D. Sinyard, Lauren Spigel, Max Riley, Paul Gregory, Nick Perdomo, Yves Sonnay, Steven Yule, Steven J. Fishman, Douglas S. Smink
pmc-11661714.description: Background:Surgery has seen limited adoption of 360-degree feedback tools, and no current tools evaluate intraoperative performance from a technical, nontechnical, or teaching skill perspective. We sought to evaluate the overall findings and perceived value of a novel 360-degree feedback tool for surgeons from their operating room colleagues.Methods:The ‘intraoperative 360’ (i360) combined 3 previously validated scales of surgeon performance.

pmc-11674965.title: Connectivity in the Dorsal Visual Stream Is Enhanced in Action Video Game Players
pmc-11674965.creator: Kyle Cahill, Timothy Jordan, Mukesh Dhamala
pmc-11674965.description: Action video games foster competitive environments that demand rapid spatial navigation and decision-making. Action video gamers often exhibit faster response times and slightly improved accuracy in vision-based sensorimotor tasks. Background/Objectives: However, the underlying functional and structural changes in the two visual streams of the brain that may be contributing to these cognitive improvements have been unclear.

pmc-12547925.title: A systematic review on frailty indices utilized in oncologic surgery and radiotherapy for metastatic spine disease: A critical appraisal of components and performance
pmc-12547925.creator: Ali Haider Bangash, Rose Fluss, Sertac Kirnaz, Jason D. Nosrati, Byung-Han Rhieu, Justin Tang, Madhur K. Garg, Saikiran G. Murthy, Yaroslav Gelfand, Reza Yassari, Rafael De la Garza Ramos
pmc-12547925.description: Highlights•Frailty indices for metastatic spine disease show inconsistent outcome prediction.•None of the frailty indices captures patient energy measures.•A novel frailty index is needed to guide treatment between surgery and radiotherapy. Introduction Frailty is a complex, multidimensional syndrome characterized by decreased physiological reserve and increased vulnerability to stressors [1].

pmc-12666521.title: Comprehensive assessment of endothelial dysfunction before cellular therapy: EASIX, local imaging, and systemic biomarkers
pmc-12666521.creator: Laura Simons, Lina Alasfar, Muath Qadoura, Jule Buhl, Franziska Sunderer, Felix Korell, Ignatios Ikonomidis, Maximilian Dietrich, Silvia Seidlitz, Hans Vink, Lena Maier-Hein, Michael Schmitt, Richard F. Schlenk, Carsten Müller-Tidow, Peter Dreger, Thomas Luft
pmc-12666521.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Key Points•Local and systemic test methods highlight the heterogeneity and the systemic nature of human endothelial dysfunction before cell therapy.•Our findings reinforce the utility of EASIX as a clinically practical, endothelial-related biomarker.

pmc-12960412.title: Ubiquitin E3 ligase KLHL6 brings exhausted T-cells back into action
pmc-12960412.creator: Zhuoyao Chen, Alex N. Bullock, Benedikt M. Kessler
pmc-12960412.description: Persistent antigen stimulation drives CD8⁺ T-cell exhaustion in cancer and chronic infection, limiting immunotherapy efficacy. Two recent studies identify the ubiquitin E3 ligase Kelch-like protein KLHL6 as a key suppressor of T-cell exhaustion. KLHL6 is maintained in progenitor and memory-like T cells but lost upon chronic TCR signaling through PI3K–AKT–mediated inhibition of FOXO1.

pmc-13158432.title: Biomaterial-based strategies for postoperative residual tumors: From margin clearance to immune control and tissue repair
pmc-13158432.creator: Meiyan Zou, Xu Chen, Nina Li, Zihao Zhou, Weiyao Feng, Rongwei Xu, Xinyuan Zhao, Li Cui
pmc-13158432.description: Postoperative and post-ablation residual tumors represent a major yet underrecognized source of cancer recurrence, metastasis, and therapeutic failure. Distinct from primary tumors, residual lesions are typically sparse, spatially dispersed, and embedded within dynamically evolving microenvironments shaped by wound healing, inflammation, hypoxia, and immune imbalance.

pmc-13387100.title: A case of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy in an adult patient with ADA-SCID
pmc-13387100.creator: Hannah Shin, Lori Broderick, Jessica Azevedo, Caitlin Mulligan, Kari Hird, Vanessa Goodwill, Courtney Parkin, Stephanie Mortensen, Madisen Traveller, Ahmad Rayes, John Bohnsack, Donald B. Kohn, Teresa K. Tarrant, Michael Hershfield, Jonathan J. Lyons
pmc-13387100.description: This case report describes progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy in a patient with ADA-SCID status after gene therapy. Persistent metabolic dysfunction likely contributed to JC virus reactivation, highlighting this rare complication of ADA-SCID and incomplete reconstitution seen with early protocols. Case A 31-year-old male presented to the emergency department (ED) with new-onset generalized seizures.

pmc-13485639.title: Mechanical stretch promotes osteogenesis in the midpalatal suture by enhancing neutrophil fatty acid oxidation through the S1PR1/STAT3 axis
pmc-13485639.creator: Ting Jiang, Tian-Hao Wan, Min-Jie Wang, Xin-Yi Tan, Zhi-Chen Ling, Feng Yang, Jun Wang, Ning-Juan Ouyang
pmc-13485639.description: In clinical maxillary arch constriction, selecting an optimal initial distraction force may help reduce relapse associated with insufficient suture osteogenesis. Neutrophils play a crucial role in early suture osteogenesis; however, how initial distraction force regulates their function remains unclear. Therefore, this study investigated how different magnitudes of initial distraction force modulate neutrophil activity and influence suture osteogenesis.
